# Apex Collision Center

> Independent auto repair, body shop and car servicing shop at Unit 41 & 42, 4544 Dufferin Street, Toronto (York University Heights, North York), Ontario M3H 5X2. Services all makes and models (domestic, Asian, European). Diagnosis first, written upfront quote with parts and labour broken out, worn parts saved for inspection, road test on every repair. Open Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Saturday 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM, closed Sunday. Towing runs 24/7. Phone (416) 661-6665.

Customers come from North York, Toronto, Downtown Toronto, Mississauga, Scarborough, Etobicoke, Vaughan and Markham. Free parking on site. Walk-ins welcome for inspections, diagnostics, oil changes and battery checks; larger repairs are best booked ahead.

## Services
- [Lube, Oil and Filter](https://apexcollisioncenter.ca/services/lube-oil-filter.html): Full service oil changes with quality oil and a new filter, plus a courtesy inspection at every visit.
- [Diagnostic Services](https://apexcollisioncenter.ca/services/diagnostic-services.html): Computer diagnostics and hands on testing that pinpoint warning lights, strange noises and performance issues.
- [Electrical Diagnostic](https://apexcollisioncenter.ca/services/electrical-diagnostic.html): Wiring, sensors, modules and parasitic drain testing by technicians who read wiring diagrams for a living.
- [Fuel Filter Replacement](https://apexcollisioncenter.ca/services/fuel-filter-replacement.html): Fuel filter replacement that protects injectors and restores proper fuel pressure.

- [Engine Repair and Maintenance](https://apexcollisioncenter.ca/services/engine-repair-maintenance.html): Engine diagnostics, tune ups, gaskets, seals and mechanical repairs for all makes and models.
- [Coolant Flush](https://apexcollisioncenter.ca/services/coolant-flush.html): Complete cooling system flush with fresh antifreeze mixed for Canadian winters, plus pressure testing.
- [Ball Joint Replacement](https://apexcollisioncenter.ca/services/ball-joint-replacement.html): Ball joint and control arm replacement with proper torque specs and a road test on every job.
- [Fuel Pump Replacement](https://apexcollisioncenter.ca/services/fuel-pump-replacement.html): Fuel pump diagnosis and replacement with fuel pressure testing before and after the job.
- [AC Service and Replacement](https://apexcollisioncenter.ca/services/ac-service-replacement.html): AC recharge, leak detection, compressor and component replacement with proper evacuation and testing.
- [Wheel Bearings Replacement](https://apexcollisioncenter.ca/services/wheel-bearings-replacement.html): Wheel hub and bearing replacement that eliminates humming, grinding and play at the wheel.
- [Strut Assembly Replacement](https://apexcollisioncenter.ca/services/strut-assembly-replacement.html): Strut and shock replacement, including complete quick strut assemblies, for safe handling and comfort.
- [Oxygen Sensor Replacement](https://apexcollisioncenter.ca/services/oxygen-sensor-replacement.html): O2 sensor diagnosis and replacement that restores fuel economy and clears emissions codes.
- [Battery, Alternator and Starter Check](https://apexcollisioncenter.ca/services/battery-alternator-starter.html): Complete starting and charging system testing: battery, alternator, starter, cables and parasitic drains.
- [CV Axle and Shaft Assembly Replacement](https://apexcollisioncenter.ca/services/cv-axle-shaft-assembly.html): CV axle replacement for clicking on turns, torn boots and vibration under acceleration.

- [Frame Straightening](https://apexcollisioncenter.ca/services/frame-straightening.html): Computer-measured frame straightening that restores structural alignment after a collision.
- [Auto Painting](https://apexcollisioncenter.ca/services/auto-painting.html): Professional auto painting: full resprays, panel painting and colour matching with a flawless finish.
- [24/7 Towing Service](https://apexcollisioncenter.ca/services/towing-service.html): 24/7 towing across North York and the GTA. One call and a truck is on its way, day or night.

## Service details

### Lube, Oil and Filter (/services/lube-oil-filter.html)
Clean oil on schedule keeps your engine alive. Full service oil changes with quality oil and a new filter, plus a courtesy inspection at every visit.

Warning signs: Oil change sticker mileage has passed, or it has been more than 6 months; Dashboard oil light or maintenance reminder is on; Oil on the dipstick looks dark, gritty or low; Engine sounds louder or rougher than usual; You notice a burning oil smell after driving

### Diagnostic Services (/services/diagnostic-services.html)
We find the real problem before we touch a wrench. Computer diagnostics and hands on testing that pinpoint warning lights, strange noises and performance issues.

Warning signs: Check engine, ABS, airbag or traction control light stays on; Car hesitates, stalls, idles rough or lacks power; Strange noises, smells or vibrations you cannot explain; Fuel economy suddenly gets worse; A warning message appears on the dash

### Electrical Diagnostic (/services/electrical-diagnostic.html)
From dead batteries to mystery drains, we trace it. Wiring, sensors, modules and parasitic drain testing by technicians who read wiring diagrams for a living.

Warning signs: Battery dies overnight or needs frequent boosts; Lights dim, flicker, or some stop working; Power windows, locks or seats work intermittently; Blown fuses that keep blowing again; Burning plastic smell or warm wiring

### Fuel Filter Replacement (/services/fuel-filter-replacement.html)
Clean fuel delivery for smooth, efficient running. Fuel filter replacement that protects injectors and restores proper fuel pressure.

Warning signs: Engine hesitates or sputters under acceleration; Hard starting, especially after sitting; Loss of power going uphill or at highway speed; Engine misfires or stalls at idle; Fuel pump sounds louder than usual, straining against a clog

### Preventative Maintenance (/services/preventative-maintenance.html)
Small services now prevent big repairs later. Factory scheduled maintenance, fluid services and full vehicle inspections that keep you ahead of breakdowns.

Warning signs: You are near a 30, 60, 90 or 120k service milestone; It has been over a year since a full inspection; You bought a used car and want a baseline health check; A long road trip is coming up; Fluids look dark or levels keep dropping

### Brake Replacement and Repair (/services/brake-replacement-repair.html)
Stop shorter, drive safer, with complete brake service. Pads, rotors, calipers and full brake system repair with proper bedding and a road test on every job.

Warning signs: Squealing, squeaking or grinding when you brake; Brake pedal feels soft, spongy or sinks low; Car pulls to one side while braking; Vibration or pulsing through the pedal or steering wheel; Brake warning light is on, or stopping distances feel longer

### Engine Repair and Maintenance (/services/engine-repair-maintenance.html)
From tune ups to major engine work, done properly. Engine diagnostics, tune ups, gaskets, seals and mechanical repairs for all makes and models.

Warning signs: Oil or coolant spots where you park; Engine overheats or temperature gauge climbs; Ticking, knocking or tapping noises from the engine; Rough idle, misfires or loss of power; Excessive exhaust smoke or strong fuel smell

### Coolant Flush (/services/coolant-flush.html)
Protect against overheating and winter freeze ups. Complete cooling system flush with fresh antifreeze mixed for Canadian winters, plus pressure testing.

Warning signs: Temperature gauge runs higher than normal; Coolant looks rusty, brown or has particles floating in it; Heater blows lukewarm in winter; Sweet smell under the hood or low coolant level; It has been more than 5 years or 100,000 km since a flush

### Ball Joint Replacement (/services/ball-joint-replacement.html)
Tight steering and safe handling start here. Ball joint and control arm replacement with proper torque specs and a road test on every job.

Warning signs: Clunking or knocking over bumps, especially when turning; Steering feels loose or wanders on the highway; Uneven or feathered tire wear on the front tires; Vibration in the steering wheel; A technician notes play in the joint during inspection

### Fuel Pump Replacement (/services/fuel-pump-replacement.html)
Reliable starts and steady fuel pressure, restored. Fuel pump diagnosis and replacement with fuel pressure testing before and after the job.

Warning signs: Engine cranks a long time before starting; Car sputters or loses power at highway speed; Engine dies and restarts only after cooling down; Whining or humming from the rear fuel tank area; No start with fuel in the tank and a healthy battery

### AC Service and Replacement (/services/ac-service-replacement.html)
Ice cold air for the hottest Toronto summer day. AC recharge, leak detection, compressor and component replacement with proper evacuation and testing.

Warning signs: AC blows warm or only slightly cool; Air gets cold then turns warm in traffic; Clicking or grinding when the AC turns on; Musty smell from the vents; Visible refrigerant oil stains on AC lines or fittings

### Wheel Bearings Replacement (/services/wheel-bearings-replacement.html)
Silence the roar and keep your wheels rolling true. Wheel hub and bearing replacement that eliminates humming, grinding and play at the wheel.

Warning signs: Humming or roaring that gets louder with speed; Noise changes pitch when you steer left or right; Grinding noise from one wheel; ABS or traction light on with a wheel speed code; Steering wheel vibration at highway speed

### Strut Assembly Replacement (/services/strut-assembly-replacement.html)
Restore the smooth, controlled ride your car was built for. Strut and shock replacement, including complete quick strut assemblies, for safe handling and comfort.

Warning signs: Car bounces more than once after a bump; Nose dives when braking or squats on acceleration; Excessive body lean in turns; Cupped or uneven tire wear; Knocking over bumps or a floaty highway feel

### Oxygen Sensor Replacement (/services/oxygen-sensor-replacement.html)
Fix the check engine light and get your mileage back. O2 sensor diagnosis and replacement that restores fuel economy and clears emissions codes.

Warning signs: Check engine light with an O2 sensor code; Fuel economy drops noticeably; Rough idle or hesitation; Rotten egg smell from the exhaust; Failed Drive Clean or emissions test

### Battery, Alternator and Starter Check (/services/battery-alternator-starter.html)
Start every morning with confidence. Complete starting and charging system testing: battery, alternator, starter, cables and parasitic drains.

Warning signs: Slow cranking, especially on cold mornings; Clicking sound when you turn the key; Battery warning light on the dash; Lights dim at idle but brighten when you rev; Needing a boost more than once

### CV Axle and Shaft Assembly Replacement (/services/cv-axle-shaft-assembly.html)
End the clicking and get power to the wheels. CV axle replacement for clicking on turns, torn boots and vibration under acceleration.

Warning signs: Clicking or popping when turning sharply; Grease splattered on the inside of the wheel or under the car; Vibration under acceleration that smooths out when coasting; Clunk when shifting into drive or reverse; Torn or cracked CV boot spotted during inspection

### Ignition Coils and Spark Plugs Replacement (/services/ignition-coils-spark-plugs.html)
Smooth idle, strong acceleration, better mileage. Spark plug and ignition coil service that cures misfires, rough idle and hesitation.

Warning signs: Engine misfires, stumbles or shakes at idle; Flashing check engine light; Hesitation or lack of power on acceleration; Hard starting; Fuel economy gets worse for no clear reason

### Engine and Transmission Mount Replacement (/services/engine-transmission-mount.html)
Stop the clunk and feel the smoothness again. Motor and transmission mount replacement that eliminates clunks, vibration and harsh shifting feel.

Warning signs: Clunk when shifting into drive or reverse; Vibration at idle that smooths out when driving; Engine visibly rocks when revved; Thump on acceleration or deceleration; Cracked, collapsed or leaking mounts found on inspection

### Collision Body Work (/services/collision-body-work.html)
Accident damage repaired, panels straight, lines restored. Collision body repair: dent removal, panel replacement and alignment that bring your car back to factory lines.

Warning signs: Dents, creases or cracked paint from an accident or parking hit; Panels that no longer line up, with uneven gaps at doors, hood or trunk; Bumper cover that is loose, cracked or hanging; A door, hood or trunk that is hard to open or close; Paint scratched down to metal or plastic after an impact

### Frame Straightening (/services/frame-straightening.html)
Bent frame, measured and pulled back to factory spec. Computer-measured frame straightening that restores structural alignment after a collision.

Warning signs: Car pulls to one side after an accident; Uneven or rapid tire wear following a collision; Doors, hood or trunk that do not align after impact; Visible bending or wrinkling in frame rails or aprons; Another shop told you the frame might be bent

### Auto Painting (/services/auto-painting.html)
Factory-match colour, sprayed in a controlled booth. Professional auto painting: full resprays, panel painting and colour matching with a flawless finish.

Warning signs: Clear coat peeling, fading or turning chalky; Scratches or chips down to primer or bare metal; Panels that do not match after a previous repair; Rust spots breaking through the paint; You want a full colour change or refresh

### 24/7 Towing Service (/services/towing-service.html)
Stranded at 2 AM? We are already rolling. 24/7 towing across North York and the GTA. One call and a truck is on its way, day or night.

Warning signs: Car broke down and will not restart; Accident damage that makes the car unsafe to drive; Flat tire with no usable spare; Overheating that forces you to stop; Any situation where driving further would cause more damage

## Booking
Call or text (416) 661-6665 (24/7 for towing), email mustafa@apexcollisioncenter.ca, or use the booking form at /contact.html. Every repair starts with diagnosis and a written upfront quote approved by the customer.
